what: A full-bleed photo is pinned to the screen and only the windows scroll over it with the document — only while a window crosses the screen does the fixed photo show through at that spot (clip-path inset(0) clips the pinned photo). Tied directly to scroll with no curve or duration. Put a booking button and a one-line text on it and it becomes a booking window

options.--fx-h: Cell height (css), default min(1188/1920×100vw, 1188px) — at 1025 and under on the tablet layout min(890/1024×100vw, 890px), booking window on phones 100vh
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo to be pinned to the screen (child). Other text/buttons in the cell get position and sit above with z-index
options.--fx-radius: Cell corners (css) — clip-path inset(0 round …) rounds even pinned photos, default 0 · Brand clinic guide panel 1rem

note: If transform, filter or will-change is applied to a cell, pinned photos switch to being relative to the cell and move with it — don’t apply it to the cell itself
